text:
marta: FYI saw a reconnect surge on eu-prod at ~11:02. Console shows lots of reconnects and duplicate session charges. :eyes:
kevin: Any initial signal? edge, proxy, or client?
alex: Proxy traces look suspicious. Pattern: socket idle -> proxy rewrites keepalive -> resume header lost -> client retries without resume -> new session billed. Example log line: `rewrite: removed header X-Resume-Token`
marta: So proxy is the culprit for dropping resume tokens?
alex: Likely. The rewrite middleware drops unknown headers when applying keepalive patch.
bella: We need a short-term mitigation that doesnt require a full env deploy. Product wants console changes to make billing transparent first.
nate: Suggestion: add an internal-only hint header the client sets on reconnects, e.g. `X-RW-Resume-Hint: 1`. Router can tag telemetry so billing can de-dupe.
kevin: That header is low risk and can be feature-flagged. Backend will treat requests with the hint as idempotent replays for 30s.
ate: I'll add a metric: `stream.resume_hint_seen` and `stream.full_session_start`. Tag with `proxy_node`.
ate: Also plan `stream.resume_drop_rate` to measure how often resume tokens are missing when we expected them.
console-team: If telemetry tags exist we can add a dashboard that separates resume-hinted reconnects vs full starts. Well include a deduped_cost column and keep gross_cost visible.
bella: UX note: people will expect raw numbers during incidents. Keep both columns and show a tooltip explaining dedupe.
kevin: Rollout plan: (1) client/edge set hint header behind flag; (2) backend interprets hint and avoids double-billing; (3) console panel to surface deduped cost; (4) follow-up proxy fix to stop needing hint. Agreed?
alex: Fixing rewrite middleware is a proper bugfix (proxy + middleware) and will need a canary. I can open the proxy PR today, but canary tomorrow.
marta: Who owns telemetry and dashboard?
console-team: Well build the panel if telemetry is shipped. ETA internal beta by EOD.
nate: Ill push the metrics and an alert: page if reconnects/new_sessions > 2 sustained for 5m.
kevin: deploy-bot: starting feature rollout for rw-resume-hint to eu-edge 10%
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: feature=rw-resume-hint, target=eu-edge, pct=10, user=kevin, ts=1832111200
alex: Canary logs show resume_hint=1 appearing. Proxy still shows some dropped resume tokens on node eur-03.
console-team: Dashboard wired. Visual confirms spikes coincide with eur-03 proxy. Leaving notes for product.
bella: Product asked for auto-unset plan: stop adding hint once proxy fix lands. Also add TTL so client only sets hint if previous session ended <30s.
marta: Action items: Alex opens proxy PR for passthrough test; Kevin feature-flag rollout; Nate metrics + alert; console-team dashboard; Bella customer comms.
kevin: Also adding request-level trace tags: `resume_hint=1` and `resume_outcome=accepted|new` for easier tracing.
nate: Alert created.
alex: PR link: https://git.internal/r/proxy/merge/789 (WIP) includes header passthrough test.
marta: Thanks all. Re-evaluate after canary completes. If deduped billing still spikes post-fix well consider credits. :thinking_face:
